title: Captured weight and boundary leakage bound the error of sample-based spectral functions — reproduction repository
description: Reproduction deposit for N. Bonilla Vargas, Captured weight and boundary leakage bound the error of sample-based spectral functions, arXiv:2608.16436 (v3). It contains the manuscript sources (main text and Supplemental Material), the computation scripts, the deposited data behind the figures and the quoted numbers, and an automated guardian (python src/verify.py, 872 checks over 9,889 numeric assertions) that recomputes the underlying physics by exact diagonalization and checks the deposit against it; the parts that are not reproducible from the deposit (the recolouring of two figure rasters, the raw hardware counts, the pyscf-dependent recomputation) are listed in docs/KNOWN_DISCREPANCIES.md. Code under the MIT licence; manuscript, data and documentation under CC BY 4.0.
